say:1:1033703001:1.text: Try not to inhale too much. It could be poisonous.
say:1:1033703001:1.source_cn: 不要用力去闻，这些气味可能带有毒素。
say:1:1033703001:1.male: Try not to inhale too much. It could be poisonous.
say:1:1033703001:1.female: Try not to inhale too much. It could be poisonous.

say:2:1033703002:1.text: My throat started burning after I took a deep breath earlier.
say:2:1033703002:1.source_cn: 我刚才只不过稍微大口呼吸了一次，喉咙就感到了刺痛。
say:2:1033703002:1.male: My throat started burning after I took a deep breath earlier.
say:2:1033703002:1.female: My throat started burning after I took a deep breath earlier.

say:3:1033703003:1.text: This foul stench lingering in the village might be the reason why the residents left.
say:3:1033703003:1.source_cn: 这些弥漫在村庄里的腐臭味，可能是沐霖村的村民逃离这里的...
say:3:1033703003:1.male: This foul stench lingering in the village might be the reason why the residents left.
say:3:1033703003:1.female: This foul stench lingering in the village might be the reason why the residents left.
